fusions.name: Drive the Herd
fusions.desc: Spreads your arms wide and walks them forward, dealing 10 damage to every enemy in a cone 4 tiles ahead and driving each one back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Ring Brand
fusions.desc: Presses a sucker hard onto the target for 5 damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 5 seconds, with a 35% chance that the ring it leaves keeps the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Bellwether Anchor
fusions.desc: Fastens your suckers to the ground and pulls up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Blood, Strong Pull

riders.text: a long haul tires you less
and what the day wears off you grows back
and every arm is ready again sooner

fusions.desc: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your stamina recovers 15% faster, from silver your health recovers 10% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 5% sooner.
